facts.text: Food here is love. Eat first and the questions can wait, Rachel.
facts.why: Set out as Nick's spoken words under 'A word from the kitchen', but he never says it. His real answer when Rachel asks if his family is rich is 'We're comfortable.' (Wikiquote).
facts.fix: Order everything. We're comfortable, so it's on me.

fix_note.text: Order everything. We're comfortable, so it's on me.

vibe.verdict: A lively hawker centre takeaway with the right food and the mahjong and dumpling scenes, but the signed note is invented and the film's biggest twists are missing.
missing: The gutted fish and 'gold digger' message left in Rachel's hotel bed
Peik Lin's gold house ('Donald Trump's bathroom')
Rachel handing Eleanor the winning mahjong tile
Eleanor's engagement ring and Nick proposing with it
'Yellow on the outside, white on the inside' (Peik Lin on Eleanor's view of Rachel)
The wedding at Gardens by the Bay with the dyed caviar
ideas: Swap 'Mahjong table garlic chilli peanuts' note for 'Rachel hands over the winning tile.'
Swap 'Family dumpling making' note for Eleanor's ring speech over the dumplings.
Swap 'Fried radish cake, black and white' for the Newton fried carrot cake stall seen in the film.
Swap the 'Your fortune' card for 'Gold digger' on a fish tag, using the hotel bed message.
iconic: The mahjong game, "Only a fool folds a winning hand"
changed: Mahjong peanuts note now carries Eleanor's line "Only a fool folds a winning hand"
